CORRECTION_1_JULY_FAITHFUL_CLAIM.claim_as_written: the rev4b amendment, tool docstring and report describe the stage as 'July-faithful'
CORRECTION_1_JULY_FAITHFUL_CLAIM.verdict: NOT DEMONSTRABLE AS AN UNQUALIFIED CLAIM. The correct statement is: FAITHFUL TO THE JULY 11/07 DAgger OPERATOR, DIVERGENT IN BALANCE
what_is_demonstrably_faithful: hyperparameters verified from source: epochs 400, batch 64, lr 3e-4, validation_fraction 0.20, patience 60, clip_weight 1.0, logstd_weight 0.1, anchor_weight 1e-5, seed 123, trace_repeat 4, no gradient clipping
aggregation operator verbatim: concat(teacher, tile(visited, repeat)), NO truncation and NO dedup (aggregate_dagger_traces)
time-aligned labels with teacher_index = step - 1 and fail-closed step contiguity
logstd restored and clock columns zeroed after every optimizer step
what_is_NOT_faithful: BALANCE: the on-policy share is 75.82% (1568 of 2068) against July r1's 35.23% (272 of 772), because the S1A prefix is 392 rows against July's 68
the frozen contiguous holdout 201-300 is absorbed into the fit (declared in rev4b)
the July physical scaling is used in the fit parametrisation (declared in rev4b)
CORRECTION_1_JULY_FAITHFUL_CLAIM.authoritative_wording: wherever rev4b or its report says 'July-faithful', read 'faithful to the July 11/07 DAgger operator, with a declared balance divergence of 75.8% vs 35.2% on-policy share'

CORRECTION_2_MISLABELLED_KEYS_IN_THE_ROL.defect: the rev4b rollout receipt's diagnostics.closed_loop_comparison block was produced by calling the L20 module's comparison function (v26b_l20_rollout.closed_loop_comparison), so it carries L20-named keys while holding rev4b VALUES
CORRECTION_2_MISLABELLED_KEYS_IN_THE_ROL.not_a_data_error: the numeric values are rev4b's own and are correct: kinematics_L20.ankle_q equals analysis.trajectory_quality.ankle_q exactly (min +0.023969903588294983). Only the KEY NAMES and one context block are mislabelled

authoritative_relabelling.diagnostics.closed_loop_comparison.scope: the phrase 'states L20 actually visited' READS AS 'states REV4B actually visited'

context_block_belonging_to_another_actor.content: source 'L20 fit receipt', action_drift_vs_S0D [0.0649, 0.0815], A2_action_drift_vs_S0D [0.0657, 0.0455], S1A_action_drift_vs_S0D [0.384, 0.289]
context_block_belonging_to_another_actor.authoritative_reading: these are L20's, A2's and S1A's offline constants, NOT rev4b's. They are contextual reference values inherited from the L20 module and must not be read as rev4b measurements

CORRECTION_2_MISLABELLED_KEYS_IN_THE_ROL.root_cause: reuse of a per-actor diagnostic function whose key names hard-code the actor it was written for; the function should take the actor label as a parameter
CORRECTION_2_MISLABELLED_KEYS_IN_THE_ROL.forward_rule: any future stage must parameterise the comparison labels by actor, or rename the keys at write time, so a receipt never carries another actor's identifiers
